audit.summary: Confirmed major: 2 Confirmed minor: 8 Core result refuted: True
limitations: P1 — The main local density counts zero instead of the target N — Counterevidence: Replacing Q=0 by Q=N makes the 2-adic factor zero for N=1. This witness then supplies no contradiction.

P2 — Symmetric Young near-extremizers may lie on a nonidentity coset — Counterevidence: Actual nu=(mu_opposite*mu)^(2^(t-1)) has a positive-semidefinite convolution operator; delta_s has a negative eigenvalue and is not such a nu. A correctly normalized special lemma may succeed.
P3 — Wrong determinant coefficient — Counterevidence: Both constants are nonzero, so the intended nondegeneracy equivalence survives.
P4 — Distinct-eigenvalue locus called closed — Counterevidence: The repeated-root discriminant locus is closed; the paper's intended generic nature is consistent with its complement.
P5 — Missing modulus bound in the first part of Corollary6.3 — Counterevidence: For q<=KX the box count (X/q+1)^8=O_K(X^8/q^8) is valid, and actual minor-arc use is in that range.

P6 — Wrong integral dimension and Fourier localization normalization — Counterevidence: The exponent4 in the desired Fourier bound is achievable, so the downstream M^5 conclusion is not refuted. The apparent cube exponent2 from extraction was disproved by actual image inspection.
P7 — Finite Fourier character and q^2 factor missing — Counterevidence: The source's own CRT and earlier definition identify the correction; the actual Weil representation is not contradicted.

P8 — Stabilization recurrence omits resets after dimension jumps — Counterevidence: These are abstract sequences satisfying the cited inequalities, not a claimed sequence from actual convolution measures. Qualitative bounded stabilization is still available.
P9 — Coset-intersection union bound omits ambient cardinality — Counterevidence: With m=O(log p) and missing density O(p^-c), the corrected bound is>(p-1)/2 for large p and generates all of Fp*.

P10 — Every splitting type need not occur for a fixed generic form — Counterevidence: All five types are legitimate possibilities across different forms; the proof's case analysis needs only that exhaustive list, not occurrence for each form.
Limitations: The main formula is refuted exactly as printed with Q=0 local congruences. The intended theorem with Q=N factors is not refuted.
Limitations: The C2 counterexample refutes the general CorollaryC.3, not Proposition8.4 for the actual positive-semidefinite convolution measures. An adequate replacement lemma still requires proof.
Limitations: P8 disproves the abstract inference from the inequalities used, not an asserted sequence produced by the actual measures.

Limitations: The Lang-Weil coefficient and p>=5 formulation are clarifications without a counterexample to the paper's actual collision varieties or small-prime group claim; neither is counted as a confirmed issue.
Limitations: All findings bind to the exact2021 arXivv1; the frozen2025 journal identity is preserved and version equivalence is not assumed.

Limitations: Selected complete relevant primary-reference proof units were checked, not all literature recursively. Neuhauser text extraction was unusable and retained images provided the actual reading.
Limitations: No author code executed. No exact-version supplementary package identified in the bounded search; absence is not a mathematical defect.
Limitations: UI identity is controller-observed; runtime GPT-6 Astra Pro. Backend equivalence not independently verified.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
